**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

- **Direction check:** Section 7.6's MFN runs *in our favour* (Vendor warrants Fees will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers). Per the rule's detection guidance, that is welcome and not flagged.
- **No Customer-side MFN:** Section 12.3 affirmatively records that Northwind has made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **No adjacent mechanics:** No right-to-match, best-terms disclosure, or third-party-offer obligation appears in Sections 2, 4, 7, 12, 23 or 30, or elsewhere in the document.

This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no upgrade or redline was proposed.
